name: ATON Green Storage
summary: ATON Green Storage S.p.A. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of energy storage solutions, primarily for solar power installations and general battery storage applications. Their comprehensive product portfolio includes residential storage systems such as the RA.Store-K and Z.Store. For photovoltaic setups, they offer the RA.Store-3, an accumulator that incorporates a three-phase hybrid inverter. Additionally, the company provides wall-mounted options like the G.Store and H.Store, as well as the versatile Zon.E system, designed to operate whether a photovoltaic array is present or not. Diversifying its offerings, ATON also produces the Axis.T, a wall-box for charging electric vehicles. Established in 2014, the company is based in Spilamberto, Italy.
